name: Youran
source:
She is hard-working, diligent, and albeit stubborn when it comes to putting others before herself. She works as a producer, and she took up a show called Miracle Finder, which was a popular show her father used to own back in the days. After producing its last episode, she and the rest of her company set out to produce advertisements, commercials, and other forms of media.

[Edited from [url=https://mrlove.wiki/wiki/Main_Character/]Mr. Love Wiki[/url]]
